notes.title: Developer Blogpost Nov. 4, 2024
notes.content:
Greetings to our glorious [b]Adventurers[/b] !
First and foremost, we apologize for the long silence in addressing our community with game updates for Trimurti Online. 

Trimurti Online is self-funded by [b]GameOlic Development Studios[/b], and its funding entirely depends on the third party projects.
It is a bit unfortunate that since May, we haven't got any.
So, we had no choice but to reduce our expenses to a minimum to keep the servers online.
Albeit slow we have been diligently working on the game updates since May.

We are very committed to bringing a game without a cash shop or item mall. 
And for the founder's pack, we felt that it is not yet the time and we feel it would be wrong to sell something while the game is at this stage.

[b]On to updates:[/b]
There were major issues that caused delays and that took precious time to get addressed. 
Within this time frame, we have upgraded the game engine twice from 5.1 to 5.3 and then to 5.4. 
This upgrade was necessary in order to fix the landscape issue where the previous engine (UE5.3) upgrade broke. 
This new engine update brought us few significant upgrades to the game. 
One of the few boons is that we are now using a new spawn system. 
A weather system with integration of night and day cycles and a performance boost by using IRIS and more. 
Along with that technical upgrade, we also reworked the UI widgets that were in placeholder since Alpha Testing. 
We fully reworked the inventory system so that it can now be easily upgradeable for future and as well as easier to maintain and manage. 
The quest widget also got an overhaul and now allows you to selectively pin and unpin the quests you want to do first.
Speaking of quests, we also updated the TaskKill and BringTask requirements for the main story quest. 
So, you can now complete the main story quest faster. 
In relation to the quests, the monster spawns also got an upgrade, you will now see a significant increase of monster spawns within their respective areas.

With that said, we are far from done and there are a lot of features still under development. 

In addition, we are still working on our life skill system.
Stay tuned for future announcements regarding life skilling.

Lastly, we thanked all the avid fans and players who continually showed support in Trimurti Online. 
Your reports and feedback are what pushed us to make Trimurti Online better on each update! 
Until then, the next post you'll see is the patch note!
 
You can ask us anything related to Trimurti Online in #🌎-ama-trimurti channel.
Link: https://discord.com/channels/1015213588371218542/1303005786737344553

Sincerely,
GameOlic Dev Team

notes.title: New Core Formula Changes Notice
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44281218/e55389a477d38051aba75ebe51fbcb068a1ed9eb.png[/img]

Greetings Adventurers!
Last update we introduced the new core formula of the game that both players & monsters will be using.
There were confusions since a lot of the previous formula was reworked and updated.

This blog post will explain how the new formula works without getting into technicalities.

Below are the details related to the combat routine update.

[h3]Damage Calculation Changes[/h3]
- The primary chakra stat that boosts Monk’s damage is now muscle, with nerve as the secondary stat.
- The primary chakra stat that boosts Wizard’s damage is now mental, with nerve as the secondary stat.
- The Monk’s damage calculation has been updated to compensate for the shift to muscle as the primary stat. 
- A new damage formula was introduced for the Wizard, enhancing their damage and compensating for the shift to mental.

[h3]Elemental Damage, Elemental Resistance & Weaknesses[/h3]
- Enemies now have elemental resistances and weaknesses. Monsters with resistance to an element can receive up to 80% less damage, while monsters with a high weakness can take up to an additional 80% damage (currently, only Wizard abilities are associated with elements, but we are not ruling out the possibility of including elements in specific abilities for other races).

[h3]Level Gap Mechanic[/h3]
- A mechanic has been introduced that amplifies or dampens the damage a player deals to a monster if the level difference exceeds 5. Once this threshold is surpassed, the damage will increase or decrease based on the level difference between the attacker and the target, with a maximum gap of 40. This same logic applies to monsters attacking players.
- The attack type mechanic against armor types has also been extended to affect playable characters. This change will alter the damage received by monsters based on the monster type and the player’s armor type. 

[h3]Critical Hit Chances & Misses (Misc)[/h3]
- The way skill success rate and critical hit probability are calculated has been updated. Now, skills with a 100% success rate can also trigger a critical hit.
- In conjunction with the gap calculation that eliminates the possibility of missing an attack, the critical hit probability of a skill will now increase if the level difference between the attacker and the target is greater than 20. 

If you have questions, do not hesitate to reach us out in our discord server.

[b]We call this regional server. [/b]
Regional Servers can communicate between other regional servers and players are able to jump between them as well.
The only difference is that when you play on the regional server that is closest to you, your latency drops significantly and lets you enjoy a smooth gaming experience due to low latency.
[i]Regional server may not be available in the demo client.[/i]

notes.title: Playtest success, Thank you adventurer!

The Playtest which ran from December 1st, 2023 to January 7th, 2024 will come to completion.

[h2]Reaching out to the community[/h2]
We understand that we have a responsibility to update steam store page for news & updates, we apologize for the lack of communications to our Steam Adventurers. 

We have weekly updates in our Steam page and thought that was enough, we will do better in the future.

We are re-enabling the gear enhancement system by next week as well as add Jina, the 3rd major map of the game.

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where sub weapon has wrong tooltip.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera is stuck when you use ESCAPE Key to close the customization window.
[*] Fixed an issue where the character can move while the customization window is opened.
[*] Fixed an issue where the unsellable items are permanently locked when you open npc shop.
[*] Fixed an issue where the camera is not focused on character when you open Customization shop.
[*] Smoothen the camera speed change in Drone Mode.
[*] Added a System Log that states what killed you.
[*] Fixed the issue where God Emblem is not showing in the character Lobby.
[*] Added SFX when using consumables from the hotbars/quickslot.
[*] Fixed an issue where player control is still active while player is dead.
[*] Fixed an issue where the other player names are not shown & sometimes disappears.
[*] Fixed an issue where party members gets a portion of gold from doing quest.
[*] Chat bubbles are now hidden when you hide all ui using ALT+H.
[*] A system log will now state who killed the player.
[*] Fixed an issue where Naga does not do its walking animation when moving.
[*] You can now target party members when clicking on the Player name in your party window.
[*] Re-textured Srbinda Tribe to make it more noticeable.
[*] Added UPPA to Mandara Dungeon boss.
[*] Resized all the Mandara bosses.
[/list]

notes.title: September 26, 2023 Update Details
notes.content:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XrO4h2P.png[/img]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where tooltips is not showing in NPC Shops.
[*] All Quests now tells you who to talk to after completing a task.
[*] Added SFX when you place items into quickslots.
[*] Fixed an issue where members in party can receive gold rewards when someone from their party completes a quest.
[*] Fixed an issue where whisper gets broken when you send a blank message.
[*] Added a feature where you can now select which Bulletin Board Quest to take.
[*] Adjusted the exclamation point locations from certain monsters.
[list]
[*] Kaulitara
[*] Ananga
[*] Ananga Dvanta
[*] Heruka
[*] Azna Heruka
[/list]
[/list]
[list]
[*] Items that cannot be traded/sold are disabled when you open an NPC Shop.
[*] Fixed an issue where player is able to move while quest window from NPC is open.
[*] Players can now freely select which subjugation quest to get!
[*] Players cannot be traded or invited to party while interacting with NPC.
[*] Added an indicator check mark when you complete a quest.
[*] You can now randomly create a character setting during character creation.
[*] Fixed an issue where the invisible party widget is overlapping with other game windows.
[*] The game now announces when someone follows a God after doing Libertine quest.
[*] Fixed missing Memory Maiden text names in game.
[/list]
